title: Umbel provenance envelope, version 2
description: Where a record came from, carried on every stored record and every event from phase 3 on (D71). Version 2 is version 1 with authority closed (null, or person, agent, tool, transcript, import, document or external), redactions given its meaning, and two new fields: constraints, the limits the source stated on use, and confirmation, filled only by the host for memory-confirm. Documents and records keep authority null, meaning not applicable; the memory store refuses null, and the host fills it for a memory record whatever the writer sent. Store writes refuse origin unspecified and a missing access or sensitivity (STORE_PROVENANCE_REQUIRED). Reserved, and refused by version 2: delegationChain, tenant. Rows and lines written in versions 0 and 1 stay as written and are read in their own version.

plugin.description: The plugin instance whose command produced the record, filled by the host from the call; null for host built-ins.

agent.description: The actor when its kind is agent, service or script; otherwise null.

principal.description: The call's effective principal string, such as human:local; null for a call with no actor.

authority.description: What the host can vouch for about the source. null for documents and records; the memory store refuses null. Not an attestation: person rests on a terminal check until phase 5.

sources.description: The OKF sources list as the record states it, at most 64 entries.

generated.description: OKF's { by, at }; at carries a UTC offset.

contentHash.description: sha256:<64 hex> of the record's bytes.

derivedFrom.description: The records this one was derived from, at most 64.

redactions.description: What hygiene masked, by secret kind, sorted by kind, each kind once (sorting is checked when the envelope is read). Never the text.

constraints.description: Limits the source stated on use, such as staging only. Scanned like the record's text; phase 4 carries them through consolidation.

confirmation.description: Filled only by the host, for memory-confirm: who vouched for the record, when, and the authority it had before. A value a plugin sends is overwritten.

actor.description: AFD's Actor; it follows AFD's contract version.

principal.description: <kind>:<id>: kind is human, agent, service or script; the id is 1 to 128 characters without a control character.
